description_en: Calls the BindSlb operation to attach a Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance to a specified application
description_zh: 调用BindSlb接口绑定SLB到指定应用
kebab_example: aliyun edas bind-slb --app-id 3616cdca-000000000 --slb-id lb-wz96ph63r000000000000 --slb-ip 192.160.0.0 --type intranet --listener-port 80 --vserver-group-id rsp-cige6000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BindSlb

parameters.description_en: The ID of the Enterprise Distributed Application Service (EDAS) application.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the Enterprise Distributed Application Service (EDAS) application
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.description_en: The ID of the SLB instance.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the SLB instance
parameters.name: slb_id

parameters.description_en: The IP address of the SLB instance.
parameters.help_en: The IP address of the SLB instance
parameters.name: slb_ip

parameters.description_en:
The network type of the SLB instance. Valid values:

- internet: an Internet-facing instance.

- intranet: an internal-facing instance.
parameters.description_zh:
SLB网络类型，取值如下：
* internet：外网实例。
* intranet：内网实例。
parameters.help_en:
The network type of the SLB instance. Valid values:

- internet: an Internet-facing instance.

- intranet: an internal-facing instance
parameters.help_zh:
SLB网络类型，取值如下：
* internet：外网实例。
* intranet：内网实例
parameters.name: type

parameters.description_en: The ID of the vServer group for the internal-facing SLB instance.
parameters.description_zh: 内网 SLB 虚拟服务器组 ID
parameters.help_en: The ID of the vServer group for the internal-facing SLB instance
parameters.help_zh: 内网 SLB 虚拟服务器组 ID
parameters.name: vserver_group_id
